releaseNotes: Completely rebuilt update pop-up dialog with sleek, content-fitted geometry eliminating all empty space
Streamlined status cards for update-available, up-to-date, checking, and offline states
Updated Enhanced Trait preset 'Trait Boost' to only apply the Fades flaw without pre-selecting Strength
Fixed '?' description button for advantages with apostrophes (e.g. Beginner's Luck)
